description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Smarty_Resource_Custom' that serves as a template resource plugin for the Smarty templating engine. It provides a wrapper implementation for custom resource plugins, including methods for fetching templates, retrieving modification timestamps, populating source metadata, and obtaining template content.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Custom
classes.description: An abstract class that implements a wrapper for custom Smarty resource plugins, providing methods to fetch templates, populate source metadata, and retrieve content.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch template content and modification time from the data source.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Fetches the template's modification timestamp. Optional to implement.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a Smarty_Template_Source object with metadata such as filepath, UID, timestamp, content, and existence flag.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Loads and returns the template's source content; throws exception if unable to read.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Determines the basename for the compiled template filename based on the source name.
